name: Asriel
overview: Asriel is a male figure from the tribe of Manasseh, identified uniquely as the son of Gilead. He is noted in Scripture as the progenitor of the Asrielites, a clan within the tribe of Manasseh. His mention is brief but significant in the genealogical records of Numbers 26:30-31.
namesAndTitles: The name Asriel means 'G-d has filled with joy' or '[the object of] joy is G-d,' reflecting a meaningful theophoric element common in Hebrew names. This proper name is not indicated as given directly by God but carries a rich spiritual significance.
familyAndRelationships: Asriel is explicitly identified as the son of Gilead. Beyond this father-son relationship, Scripture does not record additional family connections for Asriel.
scriptureSignificance: Asriel's importance lies primarily in his role as an ancestor within the tribe of Manasseh, contributing to the tribal structure of Israel. The Asrielites, his descendants, are recognized as a distinct group in the census and genealogical listings, underscoring the continuity of God's covenant people through family lines. His mention in Numbers highlights God's faithfulness in preserving the tribes of Israel through successive generations.
